name: Grist
description: An insectoid planeswalker who is both a single organism and the queen of a hive that constitutes her body mass.

description_citations.text: "Grist". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ajani searches the swarm, discovers Grist and speaks with her.
timeline.quote: Ajani searched the swarm for a soul with a spark and, in doing so, discovered and spoke with Grist.

citation.text: "Grist", section "In other media". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo suggests Grist feed on the Wilds of Eldraine instead of Mossverge's fields, and Grist agrees.
timeline.quote: Grist agreed to relocate the feast

citation.text: "Grist", section "In other media". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grist connects with local swarms to assemble a new form whenever she travels to a new plane.
timeline.quote: When she travels to a new plane, she connects with the local swarms to assemble a new form.

citation.text: "Grist". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: An insect planeswalker from an undisclosed plane whose essence inhabits insect swarms.
